The write answer's `now: {state, completion}` is always the root's (Servex/agents/page_tools.js:1053), even when the delta walks into a child (`{"<id>": {"complete": {}}}`), so a caller that wants the child's new state still needs a read. Worth one sentence in Servex/doc/item-tool.md, or answer the targeted child's state instead.

The same "write, then read the picture back" helper is written three times: honest-completion.test.mjs:14, verb-note.test.mjs:12 and item_tool.test.mjs:19 (`read_back`). One shared helper beside the tests would be simpler.

The diff itself leaves Servex/doc/item-tool.md and core/Task/readme.md saying a write answers the state. The follow-up commit e8dfa2bc4 on worktree/qf-3 fixes both, so merge the two commits together. core/Task/doc/process.md:89 still says the tool "answers with the computed state" with no read/write split.

The `log_cost` cache (Servex/agents/Agents.js:748) is keyed on each log's size and mtime only. If an agent's `provider` changes in the registry while its log stays the same, the cache returns the old cost. That's unlikely and cheap to accept.
